messages:
alice: FYI BrightCart on Dedicated seeing sustained 429s and TPS drop for the last ~30m. Customer says autoscale isn't catching up, lots of queued requests.
ben: Account? region? any customer-provided logs?
alice: Account ID BC-981, us-west-2. Attaching quick repro from their traffic spike: they ramped from 50rps -> 800rps in ~2m, started seeing 429s at ~120s. curl example from their client:```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redwood-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"..."}'```
carla: I pulled some probe logs from their Dedicated cluster. Noticing a bunch of attach timeouts and image pull failures around the same window. snippet:```Sep 17 15:02:13 kubelet[...]: Back-off pulling image "registry.example.com/llm-backend:latest"
Sep 17 15:02:14 kubelet[...]: Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch token: unauthorized
Sep 17 15:02:15 attach-controller[...] WARN attach timeout for pod bc-gen-xyz (10s)```
david: Hmm this aligns with an IAM service-account rotation we ran at 15:00 for that region. If node/daemonset can't get fresh pull creds, image pulls will fail and warm pool will deplete. Autoscaler sees fewer ready warm pods and further probes time out -> scaleup stalls.
emily: Can we confirm autoscaler decision logs? I want to see if it suppressed scale due to perceived headroom. Example from a decision log we expect:```scale_decision: {requested: 200, ready: 28, warm_pool: 5, headroom_estimated: 0, action: no_scale (probe_pending)}```
carla: I captured the autoscaler RPC trace for that interval. There were repeated probe timeouts and the attach queue size spiked. Also saw registry 429s from the control plane hitting the external registry rate limits.
ben: So chain is: IAM rotation -> registry auth failures -> image pull/backoff -> warm pool depletion -> probe/attach timeouts -> autoscaler either underestimates or stalls. Makes sense.
alice: Customer asked for immediate mitigation, they want traffic restored. Any short-term fixes we can apply without rolling out infra changes?
emily: Short-term options: 1) bump min_replicas for their Dedicated allocation to keep extra warm capacity (fast). 2) temporarily increase reserved-burst capacity if available. 3) force pre-pull of images onto nodes (manual job).
david: Also we can re-run the registry credential refresh for that account region (rotate back/force refresh) — that'll unblock pulls quickly. I'll coordinate with infra.
carla: I applied a quick pre-pull job to a subset of nodes in the customer pool and set their min_replicas += 3 via console (didn't exceed quota). Observed warm pool recovered in ~45s and 429s dropped. Customer confirmed latency improving. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: ALERT: dedicated/brightcart/high-attach-timeouts fired 2026-09-17T15:03:12Z (count=47)
ben: Good. We should capture repro steps so we can productize mitigations. From support side I'll collect exact curl traces, timestamps, and the customer's traffic pattern.
emily: Action items: - eng-platform: add circuit to detect registry auth failures during SA rotations and force credential refresh. - eng-runtime: make autoscaler more resilient to short probe floods (tolerate N attach timeouts before suppressing scale). - support: collect customer traces and keep customer updated.
david: Created infra ticket INFRA-8321 to add registry refresh hook.
carla: Created support follow-up SPT-4519 with customer logs and timeframe.
alice: Customer was told we applied pre-pull and bumped min_replicas; they asked for a timeline for a permanent fix. I promised a follow-up within 48h.
emily: Quick repro steps for eng teams: 1) simulate SA rotation in a test pool 2) flood with 500rps to simulate ramp 3) watch image pulls, attach queue, and autoscaler decisions. Commands:```# rotate SA (test) ./infra/rotate-sa.sh --account bc-test
# traffic generator: ./tools/loadgen --rps 500 --duration 300 --endpoint https://dedicated-test.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
david: For immediate prevention we should also add a small grace window in autoscaler config: allow transient attach failures for up to 30s before marking capacity lower. I'll draft a safe config change.
ben: Any docs update? Customer asked how to avoid this in future. We should add a KB: dedicated best-practices for registry/auth rotations + recommended min_replicas guidance.
carla: Noted. I'll draft KB and link SPT-4519.
alice: marking resolved for customer for now (they acknowledged). Setting this thread to follow-up for postmortem. Thanks all.
